visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a grey hoodie appearing through a circular white frame against a tiled balcony background; he looks shocked with wide eyes and mouth open. Large stylized black-and-white text characters appear in the foreground while clothes hangers are visible behind him. (2) He moves into a full frame on the balcony, gesturing with his hands as yellow and white subtitle overlays appear at the top and bottom. The lighting is natural daylight, and he maintains a high-energy facial expression. (3) The scene transitions to a brightly lit indoor studio-style background where he holds two bottles of Lenor scent beads, one blue and one green, presenting them to the camera. (4) He points towards the bottles as variety-style text with hashtags and colorful outlines appears around him, emphasizing the product name and its benefits. (5) The man counts off three points on his fingers, accompanied by checkmark graphics and bulleted text overlays that list specific product safety features. (6) Humorous floating head icons of another man and a woman appear momentarily on screen with tear-drop graphics and comic-style speech bubbles. (7) A close-up shot shows a hand pouring small, translucent scent beads from a blue cap into a silver detergent tray of a front-loading washing machine, followed by the beads being tossed directly into the drum with black laundry. (8) A group shot of four different product variants (blue, white, yellow, pink bottles) is shown on a clean countertop with decorative botanical text describing each scent. (9) The host stands behind all four bottles in the same bright indoor setting, using enthusiastic hand gestures to deliver a final recommendation as large white text overlays the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, sharp vocal exclamation 'What!?' that immediately triggers an upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM track featuring synthesized percussion and a bright lead melody. The main speaker maintains a high arousal level and rapid speech rate to establish energy. (2) As the speaker transitions into technical product details, a series of bright 'ding' sound effects punctuate the appearance of text, while the BGM provides a consistent rhythmic bed. (3) A brief auditory interruption occurs with a second male voice asking 'Sponsorship?' in a curious tone, followed by the main speaker's rapid, playful denial over a 'whoosh' transition sound. (4) For each of the three listed product benefits, a crisp, percussive 'checkmark' SFX is layered clearly over the narration and music to emphasize structural points. (5) Short vocal fragments from secondary male and female characters are mixed in during the humorous montage phase, accompanied by stylized cartoonish 'pop' sounds. (6) A physical Foley sound of beads rattling in a plastic container is audible during the demonstration, momentarily cutting through the BGM. (7) The final phase features a continuous high-energy vocal delivery with increasing intensity as the BGM swells in volume toward a final rhythmic impact and fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Myth Debunking -> Product Endorsement -> Feature List -> Usage Demo -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote Lenor laundry scent beads by addressing common safety concerns regarding environmental hormones and phthalates. It uses an energetic host and fast-paced editing to explain that the product is safe for families with children, highlights its natural essential oil ingredients, and demonstrates ease of use.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The host holds the product, mentions the brand name 'Lenor' repeatedly, and lists its specific selling points while demonstrating how to use it.
